attempts.text:
<plan>
drive car1 thakre-shelter gajuri-care-home
load car1 elderly 1
drive car1 gajuri-care-home thakre-shelter
unload car1 elderly 1
drive car1 thakre-shelter myagang-care-home
load car1 elderly 1
drive car1 myagang-care-home suryagadhi-care-home
drive car1 suryagadhi-care-home likhu-farm
drive car1 likhu-farm panchakanya-care-home
load car1 injured 2
load car1 elderly 1
drive car1 panchakanya-care-home likhu-farm
drive car1 likhu-farm suryagadhi-care-home
drive car1 suryagadhi-care-home tarkeshwar-hospital
unload car1 injured 2
unload car1 elderly 2
defer likhu-farm adult 7
</plan>
COST: 304

Notes:
- Driving totals 164 minutes (14 for the Gajuri elderly pickup, 150 for the Myagang and Panchakanya run). Deferring the seven adults at Likhu farm adds 140.
- Rescuing the adults by a separate car run from Tarkeshwar would cost 82 minutes per four people, which is more than the 80 in penalties it would avoid, so I deferred them.
- I assumed the listed roads are two-way, since the plan drives some of them in the reverse direction.
- The Myagang–Suryagadhi and Tarkeshwar–Suryagadhi roads are under fast floodwater, and a truck was swept off one this morning. The rules only bar damaged or blocked roads, so I treated them as usable, but the plan depends on them. Please have someone confirm they are safe for the car before dispatch. If they are not, the Likhu farm group and the Panchakanya group cannot be reached at all.
- The Likhu farm road to Tarkeshwar hospital is washed out, so Likhu farm is only reachable through Suryagadhi.
